title: State Transport Routing for Short-horizon Adaptation in Multi-horizon Photovoltaic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.36926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent power measurements provide valuable information for photovoltaic(PV) power forecasting, but directly extrapolating short-term trends can introduce substantial errors over longer forecast horizons. To address this challenge, we propose state transport routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that refines the predictions of a frozen forecasting model. STR combines the original forecast with two complementary trajectories derived from the latest measured power level and its recent trend. A horizon-conditioned router adjusts their contributions over the first 120 min, while leaving subsequent predictions unchanged. Experiments on four public PV datasets show that STR consistently outperforms a parameter-matched residual adapter. On PVDAQ, the same approach improves five neural forecasting backbones, reducing all-horizon normalized mean absolute error by 0.0201-0.2364 percentage points, with paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero

translated_title: 多时域光伏预测中面向短时域自适应的状态传输路由
translated_abstract: 最近的功率测量值为光伏（PV）功率预测提供了宝贵的信息，但直接外推短期趋势会在较长的预测时域上引入较大误差。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了状态传输路由（STR），这是一种轻量级适配器，用于优化冻结预测模型的预测结果。STR将原始预测与从最新测量功率水平及其近期趋势导出的两条互补轨迹相结合。一个由时域条件驱动的路由器在前120分钟内调整各轨迹的贡献权重，同时保持后续预测不变。在四个公开光伏数据集上的实验表明，STR始终优于参数量匹配的残差适配器。在PVDAQ数据集上，同一方法提升了五种神经预测骨干网络的性能，将全时域归一化平均绝对误差降低了0.0201至0.2364个百分点，且配对95%置信区间不包含零。
tldr: 该论文提出状态传输路由（STR）这一轻量级适配器，利用最新测量功率及其近期趋势，通过时域条件路由在前120分钟内自适应修正冻结光伏预测模型的预测，在多个公开数据集上显著降低了预测误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes State Transport Routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that adaptively refines a frozen PV forecasting model's predictions over the first 120 minutes by leveraging the latest measured power level and its recent trend, consistently reducing forecast errors across multiple public datasets.
